name: Merkushi Gas Pipeline (Perm Krai)

values.OtherEnglishNames: Merkushi Gas Pipeline; Shlyki-Bogomyagkovo-Merkushi Inter-settlement Gas Pipeline
values.RouteType: Not mapped (but could be — route or endpoints are known)
values.RouteNotes: CB 2026-09-30: route not drawn. Regional gasification programme names the corridor: Shlyki - Nizhnee Gorodishche - Podzemlyannaya - Malo-Baydino - Verkh. Davydovka - Monastyrka - Bogomyagkovo, with a branch to Merkushi (Osinsky and Chastinsky districts). Candidate for the routes leg (endpoints + named villages).

researcher_notes: No match to existing GEM rows (roster Perm Krai rows are only the Nizhnyaya Tura-Perm-Gorky trunks P2351/P5712/P5714-5716; Osa/Chastye area uncovered). Threshold met: sponsor = Gazprom regional gasification programme (investor Gazprom Mezhregiongaz, per Gazprom press release 31 Jul 2020; built/operated by Gazprom Gazoraspredelenie Perm); endpoints pinned from the Perm Krai 2017-2021 gasification programme (Postanovlenie 943-p, archived 2019 snapshot): 'Gazoprovod mezhposelkovy s. Shlyki - d. Nizhnee Gorodishche - d. Podzemlyannaya - d. Malo-Baydino - s. Verkh. Davydovka - d. Monastyrka - s. Bogomyagkovo s otvodom na s. Merkushi Osinskogo i Chastinskogo munitsipalnykh rayonov', 58.0 km, 2018-2020, listed under both districts (Merkushi distribution networks 10.6 km, 40.737 mln rub, listed separately). Concrete step: gas launched at Merkushi 31 Jul 2020 (Gazprom press release, Wayback copy; the live gazprom.ru page timed out from this host; MK v Permi 31 Jul 2020 carries the same release text, so it is NOT an independent second source for status/length). LENGTH 58 km = line incl. Merkushi branch, stated by Gazprom and MK and matching the programme's 58.0 (programme is an independent document, hence independent=true). Settlements served stated inconsistently (Gazprom: 9 settlements, 2 municipal districts; MK: 7, '2 gorodskikh okrugov') - not used. Start point Shlyki is the programme's first named node; whether a Gazprom GRS or an existing distribution main sits at Shlyki was not confirmed, so StartLocation is the settlement. Not filled: Diameter, Capacity, Pressure (none sourced); cost (MK says 'svyshe 800 mln rub' total project, unverified lower bound and conflicting with the 40.7 mln Merkushi-network figure; programme gives no cost for the trunk). Owner/Parent = Gazprom PJSC is inferred from the Gazprom-programme investor statement, not a stated asset-owner; the build/operator entity (Gazprom Gazoraspredelenie Perm) is not in the tracker entity list (entity_lookup: no close match) - confirm before applying. PipelineType 'distribution' by analogy with sibling Perm/Nizhny inter-settlement shards. ProposalYear/ConstructionYear omitted (programme dates 2018-2020 are planned). Route: no route, see RouteNotes. Confidence tier high on existence/status/length; medium on Owner.
